summary: A run waiting for the perf slot no longer loses its place: its ticket is locked before it joins the line, so a concurrent status read or waiter can no longer mistake it for a dead waiter's and remove it (#5235).

replay.detail: No replay trigger or recovery wait. The perf slot is a developer and CI script; the daemon is unchanged.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or migrations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, registry or coordinated member upgrade change.

compatibility.detail: The line's tickets keep their names and directory, so waiters running the previous script and this one share a line. A ticket briefly exists as .joining-NAME beside the line before it is renamed into it.

downtime.detail: No storage migration or added startup work.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure. A .joining-NAME file left beside the line by a run killed in the instant between creating and renaming its ticket is harmless and can be deleted.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous script. Nothing is stored beyond the line's ticket files.
